preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
Each test case must have a number of cells x between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for n in range(1, int((2 * x)**0.5) + 1) if n * (n + 1) // 2 <= x))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of different nice staircases that can be built with no more than x cells.
